name: tag-editor
purpose: Key and value tags of one resource, after Cloudscape's tag editor, built on `AttributeEditor`. It adds what tags need on top of the rows: key and value suggestions while typing, a tag limit (50 by default) that ignores tags marked for removal, the built-in key checks (required when the row has a value, unique, length, allowed characters, no reserved `azion:` prefix), and a removal that only marks a saved tag, with Undo, until the form is saved.
useWhen: The Tags section of a create or settings form of any resource.
Labels used for cost allocation, ownership or search, where keys repeat across resources and suggestions help keep them consistent.
avoidWhen: Environment variables, headers or any pairs without tag rules → use `attribute-editor`.
Picking from a fixed list of labels → use `multi-select`.
related: attribute-editor` — the rows, Add, Remove, limit text, focus and announcements underneath.
input` — key and value controls; suggestions come from a native `datalist`.
tag` — how the saved tags read outside the editor.
platform/states/form-error` — the rule for server errors passed through `errors`.
bestPractices: Mark saved tags with `existing: true`: their key is read-only, and Remove marks them `markedForRemoval` (Undo puts them back) so the save request knows what to delete.
Call the exposed `validate()` on Save; it also flags empty keys, which are not flagged while typing.
Feed `keySuggestions` with the keys already used in the account so tags stay consistent.
Pass server errors per row through `errors`; they replace the built-in message of that cell.
Keep the default `limit` unless the backend has another one.

props.name: tags
props.doc: Tags being edited. Saved tags carry `existing`; Remove marks them `markedForRemoval` until Undo. Supports v-model:tags.

props.name: keySuggestions
props.doc: Keys offered while typing a key, for example the keys already used in the account.

props.name: valueSuggestions
props.doc: Values offered per key while typing a value.

props.name: limit
props.doc: Most tags allowed; tags marked for removal do not count.

props.name: reservedPrefix
props.doc: Prefix reserved for the platform; keys may not start with it. Empty allows every prefix.

props.name: errors
props.doc: Server errors per row, aligned with `tags`; shown in place of the built-in checks.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the list of tags. Empty uses the locale catalog.

events.name: update:tags
events.notes: A tag was added, edited, removed, marked for removal or restored.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import TagEditor from '@aziontech/webkit/tag-editor'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const tags = ref([
    { key: 'team', value: 'payments', existing: true },
    { key: 'cost-center', value: 'cc-1042', existing: true },
    { key: 'environment', value: 'staging' }
  ])

  const keySuggestions = ['team', 'cost-center', 'environment', 'owner', 'project']
  const valueSuggestions = { environment: ['production', 'staging', 'preview'] }
</script>

<template>
  <TagEditor
    v-model:tags="tags"
    :key-suggestions="keySuggestions"
    :value-suggestions="valueSuggestions"
    aria-label="Resource tags"
  />
</template>
